note.windows: The build takes a few minutes and under 1 GB. It needs IDA 9 with idalib for Python 3.11, which it cannot install for you. Python, Git and MSYS2 (with MinGW-w64 gcc, CMake and Ninja, about 400 MB) are installed if they are missing. Point it at the Jazz Jackrabbit CD or a copy of its files.
